Hymn 52: The Day Dawn Is Breaking
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major

This is hymn number 52 titled "The Day Dawn Is Breaking" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Leroy J. Robertson and the lyrics were written by Joseph L. Townsend.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
